parse_link_title_url: parse a reStructuredText link string into a title and URL tuple using the link_regexp pattern
build_gh_internal_url: build a GitHub URL for issues, commits, branches, or tags given an account, ref, and title
create_gh_rst_role: create a docutils reference node from a GitHub username or repository reference in reStructuredText
register_gh_role: register the gh reStructuredText role with docutils so it can be used in RST documents
summarize_gh_module: summarize the m.css GitHub role plugin that generates GitHub links from reStructuredText role syntax
